# Harness Arena

> Battle two AI coding agent setups ("harnesses") on the same task through the official, locally
> authenticated CLIs (claude, codex, gemini, opencode), capture telemetry, evaluate deterministically,
> and read a battle report. Arena never proxies model traffic and never touches provider credentials:
> model usage is paid by the subscriptions the user already has.

## What it is

- A local CLI (`npx harness-arena`) that runs two harnesses against the same repository commit and task.
- A normalized, versioned event protocol so both sides are measured the same way.
- Honest telemetry: every metric carries a status of observed, calculated, estimated or unavailable.
  A CLI that does not report cost shows "n/a", never $0.
- Deterministic evaluation first (repo tests, build, lint, typecheck, task assertions, diff signals);
  an optional LLM judge is labeled subjective.

## Docs

- /docs: overview
- /docs/cli: install and run a battle
- /docs/architecture: engine, adapters, evaluator, web app
- /docs/protocol: event protocol
- /docs/harness-protocol: arena.yaml harness manifest
- /docs/adapters: what each agent CLI can and cannot report
- /docs/security: trust boundaries
- /docs/privacy: local-only mode and upload contents
- /docs/contributing: development

## Notes for agents

- The landing page preview is demo data, labeled `demo: true` in the battle record.
- Battle pages, leaderboard and accounts are not live yet.
